name: Puddles!
description: Shaken, not... spilled? Adds puddles to several thrown items. Water and wine (electricity), alcohol (flammable) and soda (slippery).

options.name: Water
options.tooltip: Water pools from Atlantide bottle, martini shaker, and snow globe

options.name: Alcohol
options.tooltip: Makes vodka and whiskey bottles spill flammable alcohol

options.name: Alcohol (Quest items)
options.tooltip: Makes quest item vodka bottles throwable and create flammable puddles. Slightly bugged still - the bottles will become invisible when placed with their quest prompts, but still function for the quest poisonings.

options.name: Wine
options.tooltip: Throwing wine bottles creates pools of wine that can electrocute like water

options.name: Soda
options.tooltip: Throwing soda cans creates slippery puddles of soda

options.name: Safehouse | Atlantide
options.tooltip: Adds the Atlantide water bottle to the safehouse

options.name: Safehouse | Vodka
options.tooltip: Adds the regular vodka bottle to the safehouse

options.name: Safehouse | New York Vodka
options.tooltip: Adds the New York vodka bottle to the safehouse. ONLY USE IF YOU HAVE QUEST VODKA TURNED ON!

options.name: Safehouse | Jasper Knight Vodka
options.tooltip: Adds the vodka bottle from the tutorial mission to the safehouse. ONLY USE IF YOU HAVE QUEST VODKA TURNED ON!

options.name: Safehouse | Martini Shaker
options.tooltip: Adds the martini shaker to the safehouse

options.name: Safehouse | Whiskey
options.tooltip: Adds the whiskey bottle to the safehouse

options.name: Unlock | Vodka
options.tooltip: Adds the regular vodka bottle to the loadout

options.name: Unlock | Atlantide
options.tooltip: Adds the Atlantide water bottle to the loadout

options.name: Unlock | Soda
options.tooltip: Adds the soda can to the loadout

options.name: Unlock | Raccoon Vodka
options.tooltip: Adds the Raccoon vodka bottle to the loadout

options.name: Unlock | Tutorial Vodka
options.tooltip: Adds the tutorial vodka bottle to the loadout

options.name: Unlock | Whiskey
options.tooltip: Adds the whiskey bottle to the loadout
